title: Beyond the Big Day: Destination Weddings with Hilton
summary: From Texas Hill Country to Maui to Mexico, these Hilton resorts offer distinctive settings for a full wedding weekend.

From Texas Hill Country to Maui and Mexico's Pacific and Caribbean coasts, five Hilton resorts offer distinctive settings for a full wedding weekend


- **From Texas Hill Country to Maui and Mexico’s Pacific and Caribbean coasts, five Hilton resorts offer distinctive settings for destination weddings and multi-day celebrations.**
- **With Hilton’s 2027 Trends Report revealing that 74% of travelers choose accommodations based on their desired experiences, destination weddings offer opportunities to turn a single celebration into a memorable getaway.**
- **From intimate ceremonies to elaborate multicultural celebrations, Hilton’s dedicated teams help couples personalize every detail while honoring their traditions and heritage.**
- **Beyond the ceremony, resort amenities, local attractions and curated experiences give couples and their guests opportunities to connect, celebrate and explore the destination together.**


The most memorable weddings extend beyond the ceremony, bringing loved ones together for shared experiences and time to explore the destination. With[Hilton's 2027 Trends Report](https://stories.hilton.com/2027-trends) finding that 74% of travelers choose where to stay based on the experience they hope to have, five Hilton resorts offer distinctive settings for wedding weekends, from Texas Hill Country and Maui to Mexico's Pacific and Caribbean coasts.


“Weddings are deeply personal and no two celebrations should look the same,” said Ann O’Riordan, director of catering and events, Hilton. “Whether couples are planning an intimate ceremony or a multiday South Asian wedding rich with cultural traditions, our teams work closely with them to create experiences that reflect their story, honor their heritage and bring loved ones together.”


### **Hill Country Romance at La Cantera Resort & Spa, A Signia Hilton Resort**


**San Antonio, Texas**


La Cantera Resort & Spa, A Signia Hilton Resort - Wedding


Set across 550 acres of Texas Hill Country,[La Cantera Resort & Spa, A Signia Hilton Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/satcnsa-signia-la-cantera-resort-and-spa/) combines scenic beauty with warm Texas hospitality. Its newest wedding venue,[The Calera](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/satcnsa-signia-la-cantera-resort-and-spa/events/weddings/) , offers a romantic backdrop for exchanging vows, while indoor and outdoor event spaces accommodate welcome receptions, rehearsal dinners and farewell brunches.


La Cantera Resort & Spa, A Signia Hilton Resort - The Calera


Guests can enjoy nine dining experiences, five pools, championship golf courses and Loma de Vida Spa & Wellness. Located just outside downtown San Antonio, the resort also offers easy access to Hill Country wineries, shopping and outdoor recreation.


### **Island Elegance at Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort**


**Wailea, Maui, Hawaii**


Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort - Wedding


Surrounded by lush, tropical gardens and sweeping Pacific Ocean views,[Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/jhmgwwa-grand-wailea/) pairs the natural beauty of Hawaii with the signature luxury and personalized service of Waldorf Astoria. Couples can exchange vows at the Seaside Chapel or host an oceanfront reception, incorporating thoughtful touches inspired by the island's cultural heritage.


Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort - Seaside Chapel


Guests can unwind at Grand Wailea’s award-winning wellness destination, Kilolani Spa, enjoy the resort's celebrated pools and dining experiences, or venture beyond the property to explore Maui's beaches, scenic coastline and cultural attractions.


### **Oceanfront Celebrations at Hilton Los Cabos**


**Los Cabos, Mexico**


-
-


Hilton Los Cabos - Wedding


Overlooking the Sea of Cortez,[Hilton Los Cabos](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/sjdlchh-hilton-los-cabos-beach-and-golf-resort/) offers a stunning coastal setting for destination weddings. From beachfront ceremonies to receptions beneath the stars, the resort's versatile venues and dedicated wedding team allow couples to personalize their events through curated menus and thoughtful details.


Outside the festivities, guests can enjoy spa treatments, poolside afternoons and resort dining or explore Los Cabos' beaches, golf courses, sportfishing excursions and vibrant culinary scene.


### **Pacific Coast Romance at Conrad Punta de Mita**


**Punta de Mita, Riviera Nayarit, Mexico**


-


Conrad Punta de Mita - Wedding


Set along Mexico's Pacific coast,[Conrad Punta de Mita](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/pvrpmci-conrad-punta-de-mita/) combines Riviera Nayarit's natural beauty with contemporary luxury and locally inspired experiences. Couples can exchange vows on Mezquite Beach, host an oceanfront reception on Haramara Lawn or gather in the Tukipa Ballroom, with dedicated planners and customizable menus inspired by regional Mexican cuisine.


Conrad Punta de Mita - Wedding Table Setting


Guests can unwind at Conrad Spa, explore seven restaurants and bars or relax along the resort's two-mile stretch of beach. Beyond the property, boat excursions to the Marietas Islands, outdoor adventures and cultural experiences offer opportunities to discover Riviera Nayarit.


### **Caribbean Romance at Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya, an All-Inclusive Resort**


**Tulum, Riviera Maya, Mexico**


Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya, an All-Inclusive Resort - Wedding


Nestled along the Caribbean coast,[Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya, an All-Inclusive Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cuncici-conrad-tulum-riviera-maya/) blends contemporary luxury with the natural beauty and rich cultural heritage of Mexico’s Riviera Maya. With tropical surroundings, oceanfront settings and versatile indoor and outdoor venues, the resort offers a distinctive backdrop for intimate ceremonies, grand receptions and multiday celebrations tailored to each couple’s vision.


Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya - Conrad Spa Tulum


Between festivities, guests can unwind at Conrad Spa Tulum, enjoy the resort's pools and diverse dining experiences or explore the region’s ancient Mayan ruins, cenotes and pristine beaches, turning a wedding weekend into an immersive Caribbean getaway.


### **More Than a Wedding Day**


From intimate ceremonies to multiday cultural celebrations, Hilton offers dedicated teams and personalized service to bring each couple’s traditions and vision to life.


Beyond the wedding day, Hilton offers places to celebrate life’s next milestones, from honeymoons and anniversaries to future adventures together.


**Ready to start planning? Explore the possibilities at**[Hilton Weddings](https://www.hilton.com/en/events/weddings/) **.**


##### FAQ: Beyond the Big Day: Destination Weddings with Hilton


Hilton offers a diverse portfolio of hotels and resorts in sought-after destinations, giving couples the flexibility to plan celebrations that reflect their personal style, traditions and vision. From intimate beachfront ceremonies to elaborate multiday celebrations, Hilton’s dedicated wedding teams help bring each couple’s vision to life through personalized service, versatile venues and customizable experiences.


The article highlights five resorts offering distinctive wedding experiences:


- **La Cantera Resort & Spa, A Signia Hilton Resort:** Texas Hill Country scenery, versatile indoor and outdoor venues and resort amenities.
- **Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort** : Oceanfront celebrations, tropical gardens and luxury experiences inspired by Hawaii.
- **Hilton Los Cabos:** Beachfront ceremonies, personalized receptions and access to the natural beauty of Los Cabos.
- **Conrad Punta de Mita:** Pacific Ocean views, locally inspired cuisine and contemporary luxury along Mexico's Riviera Nayarit.
- **Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya, an All-Inclusive Resort:** Caribbean beachfront settings, customizable wedding experiences and venues accommodating intimate gatherings and multiday cultural celebrations.


Yes. Hilton recognizes that weddings are deeply personal and often incorporate meaningful cultural traditions. From South Asian weddings featuring multiple ceremonies and celebrations to intimate gatherings, Hilton’s wedding teams work with couples to tailor event spaces, menus and experiences to their unique needs and traditions. Specific capabilities vary by property.


Hilton resorts offer opportunities to extend celebrations beyond the ceremony through welcome receptions, rehearsal dinners, farewell brunches and other gatherings. Guests can also enjoy resort amenities such as spas, pools, golf courses and dining experiences, along with opportunities to explore local attractions.


According to Hilton's 2027 Trends Report, 74% of travelers choose where to stay based on the experience they hope to have. Destination weddings reflect this broader interest in experience-driven travel, allowing couples to bring loved ones together for meaningful celebrations while enjoying everything a destination has to offer.


Couples can explore venues, destinations and wedding offerings through[Hilton Weddings](https://www.hilton.com/en/events/weddings/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) . From there, they can connect with individual properties to discuss availability, event spaces, customizable packages and planning support.


Yes. Hilton offers destinations and experiences for life's milestones, including honeymoons, anniversaries and future celebrations, allowing couples to continue creating memories together long after their wedding weekend.
